name: std::erase_if (std::map)

declarations.code:
template <class Key, class T, class Compare, class Alloc,

    class Pred>

std::map<Key, T, Compare, Alloc>::size_type

erase_if(std::map<Key, T, Compare, Alloc> &c,

    Pred pred);

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
c

 -

 container from which to erase


 pred

 -

 predicate that returns true if the element should be erased

summary: Erases all elements that satisfy the predicate pred from c.
